Domain
A kernel's feeds are computed over a grid. Width and height set how many elements one run covers, and the image view uses the same numbers. Feed expressions see i, x, y, w, h and t — t is the frame number, so anything an expression does with it is what Animate shows.
Compiled in — changing these needs a recompile, not a re-run.
